name: Nika (character)
means: Makes the same teenage girl appear across shots on the anime engine - silver hair in one long braid, one amber eye and one green eye, a grey school blazer with red piping and a gold star pin - instead of a fresh girl who merely matches the description.
verdict: MEASURED FROM PIXELS, not from a loss number. studio/samples/cast/nika_sweep.jpg is two scenes by three strengths, one seed per row, only strength varying. THE CONTROL IS NOT A STRANGER: her tags alone already carry heterochromia, silver hair, a braid and a blazer, so 0.0 is recognisably her. What the LoRA ADDS is the specific training garment and face - at 0.0 she wears a NAVY blazer, at 0.5 and above she wears the grey blazer with red piping, the ornate gold star and the facial scar from her sheet. Neither undertrained (the control plainly differs) nor overfit (all six cells are new scenes, none is a returned training portrait). THE COST IS THE BACKGROUND AND IT IS SEVERE AT 0.85: the sunlit-field row goes from a lush golden-green field with depth at 0.0, to a flatter but intact field at 0.5, to A DARK GREY VOID with a strip of grass at 0.85 - her turnaround set's flat blue-grey studio backdrop imported wholesale. The neon street degrades the same way. 0.5 IS THE OPERATING POINT. Note that short.py's default character_lora_weight is 0.85, which for this character destroys the setting.
note: THE FIRST NON-MALE CHARACTER LoRA IN THIS PROJECT. Trained 2026-08-04, 1000 steps, rank 16, 16 images, from ~/ComfyUI/input/nika_train. MEASURED WALL CLOCK 1230 s (20.5 min) - twice the ~10 min the project's map estimated, and that estimate was inferred from two file mtimes rather than timed. PIP's run on the same settings took 1276 s, so ~20 min is the real figure for 1000 steps at rank 16 on 16 images. | base_model is animagine because workflows/33_train_character_lora.json node 2 hard-codes CheckpointLoaderSimple{animagine-xl-4.0.safetensors} and train_character.py has no --base flag. The file is 102,459,244 bytes, byte-identical in size to character_viro and character_pip, as expected for the same rank and architecture. NOT independently key-checked - unlike VIRO's card, no safetensors header inspection was done here. | MODEL-ONLY, like VIRO's: TrainLoraNode patches MODEL, so load with LoraLoaderModelOnly. compose.py:1801-1818 will mark it active on the anime engine and dead on qwen. | trigger 'nika' comes from the captions turnaround.py wrote - all 16 of ~/ComfyUI/input/nika_train/*.txt begin 'nika, '. | strength_range is a REAL SWEEP here, not a judgement: 0.0, 0.5 and 0.85 were rendered at matched seeds in two scenes and looked at. The top of the range is set to 0.85 rather than 1.0 because 0.85 already costs the setting. | CAUTION FOR THE FILM PIPELINE: she cannot be rendered correctly through compile.py -> short.py at all yet, for a reason unrelated to this LoRA - workflows/22_anime_kf_ipadapter.json node 6 hard-codes '1girl, girl, female, feminine, breasts' into the negative and short.py wires no negative input. Every image behind this verdict was rendered with that negative replaced by hand.
example_note: Left column is the control at strength 0. A LoRA is a delta on the base weights, so a single with-the-LoRA image proves nothing - the OFF cell is the evidence.
